_note: Negative control for the capsule.resolve and capsule.digest gates. Unlike the frozen negative_variant.json, its capsule_id can never be registered on the anchor, so it cannot start resolving through ordinary use. See NEGATIVE_CONTROLS.md.
_construction: 64 characters like a capsule_id, but not hex. The anchor's write routes (POST /v1/digest, POST /register) refuse any capsule_id that is not 64 hex characters, so this value is never registered; resolving it is refused too (400). The anchor's own tests pin both.
description: Same task_request.json as the positive case. The callee's response carries a capsule_id that is not the one sealed for this task and can never be one.

capsule.resolve.reason: The capsule_id is malformed (not hex); the anchor refuses to resolve it (400) and can never have registered it.

capsule.digest.reason: Cannot verify digest: no capsule to fetch. Depends on capsule.resolve passing.

verifier_procedure.step_1: GET https://anchor.agentactioncapsule.org/v1/inclusion/<capsule_id>  (read-only; never POST to check a negative: POST registers)
verifier_procedure.step_1_result: 400 Bad Request: capsule_id must be a 64-character hex string
verifier_procedure.final: Both gates DENY. The task response is non-conformant: capsule extension present but unresolvable.
